pending_message: Mop-up, ONE AT A TIME ~4 s apart: 1) RT - squeeze it slowly and firmly to the end stop, hold 2 seconds   2) M5   3) M6   4) M7   (skip any M button your unit does not have). If you have any other button I have not asked about yet (e.g. a Turbo or profile button), press it last. Then reply DONE in Hermes.
